title: Hallmark
summary: Makes websites and landing pages look made, not generated; can also redesign or audit an existing page.
details: When you ask to build or design a new website or landing page, Claude suggests /hallmark first (about $1.80 and 4-6 minutes per page) and only runs it after you say yes; it also supports /hallmark redesign <path> and audit <path>. It makes generated pages look made rather than templated, with a hard floor of rules and a sloplint script run when Node is available. It adds a skill folder plus a rule file, loads only when used, and runs local scripts when used.
risk: Instructions only; loads when used. No code runs on its own.
